name: Resistor divider (12 V → 3.84 V)
description: A 10 kΩ / 4.7 kΩ divider derives a lower voltage from a 12 V input and brings it out on connector J1.
expected_behavior: Unloaded, VOUT = 12 V × 4.7k / (10k + 4.7k) ≈ 3.84 V and about 816 µA flows through the divider.
example_questions: Why might my output voltage be low?
